subtitle: collectible cards
meta_desc: Open packs, complete your collection of 30 creatures, trade cards with your friends and challenge them to duels with your own deck.
odds_note: Each pack reshuffles all 939 cards and draws 5. The cards are yours before you even see them.
legend_note: The legendary ones ({names}) have 1 copy out of {total} each.
deck_hint: Tap a card in your collection to add it to or remove it from the deck. You need 8.
duel_desc: Your deck of 8 against another player’s. Each round one attacks and the other answers: the card with more strength wins, and the element that beats the other adds 3 (🔥 beats 🌿, 🌿 beats 💧 and 💧 beats 🔥). The first to win 4 rounds wins.
friends_pick: Pick one of their cards and one of yours to propose a trade.

guest_hint: Log in to open packs: we give you 3 to get started.
